group.string: Auto Sync Scope (select one or more)

group.help: Each sync only fetches records Magento changed since its marker.

button.name: action_reset_watermarks
button.confirm: The next sync will re-read all orders, products and customers from Magento. Continue?

field.name: help
field.p: No attribute sets yet
Run Sync Attribute Sets from an instance to import them from Magento. A set created here is also created in Magento.

field.name: help
field.p: Connect your first Magento store
Enter the store URL and an integration access token, then click Test Connection.

field.name: help
field.p: No Magento products yet
Run Sync Products from an instance to import the catalog, or create a product here and push it to Magento.

field.name: help
field.p: No stock figures yet
Stock levels appear here once products are synced from Magento. Use Refresh Inventory to fetch the latest quantities.

field.name: help
field.p: No Magento categories yet
Run Sync Categories from an instance to import the category tree.

field.name: help
field.p: No Magento orders yet
Run Sync Orders from an instance to import orders from Magento.

field.name: help
field.p: No delivered Magento orders
Orders appear here once every line has been delivered.

field.name: help
field.p: Nothing waiting for delivery
Magento orders that still have goods to ship appear here.

field.name: help
field.p: No Magento invoices yet
Invoices imported from Magento, or posted in Odoo for a Magento order, appear here.

field.name: help
field.p: No Magento credit memos yet
Credit memos are synced in both directions: refunds made in Magento are imported, and credit notes posted in Odoo for a Magento order are pushed.

field.name: help
field.p: No Magento shipments yet
Validated deliveries of Magento orders appear here once they are pushed to Magento.

field.name: help
field.p: No Magento customers yet
Run Sync Customers from an instance to import customer accounts.

field.name: help
field.p: No sync runs yet
Every manual or scheduled sync writes a report here with its record counts and errors.

field.name: help
field.p: No cancelled Magento orders
Orders cancelled in Odoo or in Magento are listed here.
